description: In every model \(M\models Q\), \(m_M+n_M=(m+n)_M\) for all external natural numbers \(m,n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeral_add.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q] (m n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M m)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M n) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M (m + n)
